Title: customerSalesReps — Paging (first/after)

Caller is ACME_BUYER. @td(ORG_ACME.id) must be served by >=3 active, unlocked reps (SR_REP_PRIMARY + >=2 more fixtures) so page 1 (first:2) has a next page and page 2 (after:2) does not overlap. [GQL-OP page2]

[GQL-EXEC page2]
Failure_Signals: page1 and page2 items[] overlap; hasNextPage false with >2 reps still unseen; errors[] non-empty

Title: salesRepCustomers — Permissioned Rep Serving Zero Customers Returns Empty (Not an Error)
Preconditions: Runner-native via [GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]. Requires the Sales Rep module deployed on the environment. Caller is SALES_REP_NOCUSTOMERS (= SR_REP_NOCUSTOMERS, rep 'Nora None', agent-test-sr-nocustomers@example.com) — a GENUINE sales rep whose JWT carries permission=sales-rep:access as a GLOBAL role but with ZERO org memberships (empty served_orgs). VERIFIED LIVE (TLC-2026-07-17-1603, vcst-qa, this run): this caller's salesRepCustomers query returns HTTP 200, totalCount=0, errors[] empty — a clean empty result, NOT an authorization failure. CAUTION: totalCount=0 alone does not prove the caller held sales-rep:access — a plain buyer with NO sales-rep:access ALSO gets salesRepCustomers 200/totalCount=0 (the scoped query gates on authentication, not on the rep permission, so a non-rep silently gets an empty set rather than a Forbidden). This case's value is specifically that a genuine, permissioned rep who happens to serve nobody gets the SAME clean empty contract as every other zero-result path (SR-GQL-009's positive-count contract, SR-GQL-040's count-only contract) — not a 403/error. Storefront counterpart: this same rep is redirected to /account/dashboard by the myCustomersRoute guard before this query would ever fire from the UI (089 SR-FE-013, browser-verified this run) — the now-deprecated 089 SR-FE-030 assumed a different (architecturally unreachable) 'org-context + zero-served' state; this case is the correct, genuinely-reachable backend equivalent.
Steps:
[GQL-ENDPOINT /graphql/sales-rep]
[AUTH role=SALES_REP_NOCUSTOMERS]
[GQL-OP main]
query { salesRepCustomers(first: 20, storeId: "{{store}}", cultureName: "{{culture}}") { totalCount items { organizationId } } }
[GQL-EXEC main]
Cross_Layer_Checks: [EVIDENCE] storefront counterpart is 089 SR-FE-013's myCustomersRoute redirect (browser-verified this run, screenshot SR-FE-013-nocustomers-redirect-dashboard.png) — the redirect fires before this query would ever be issued from the UI, so this API case is the only way to directly exercise the zero-served contract for a genuine permissioned rep
Failure_Signals: errors[] non-empty (would mean a permissioned-but-zero-served rep is treated as unauthorized, contradicting the by-design clean-empty contract); totalCount > 0 despite zero org memberships (data leak); HTTP 4xx/5xx instead of a clean 200 empty result
References: VCST-5469, VCST-5304; Generated: TLC-2026-07-17-1603 (VCST-5304/5469 corrected test design, 2026-07-17) — replaces the deprecated 089 SR-FE-030 gap-fixture approach with the genuinely-reachable backend invariant, verified live
